SugarCraft\Fuzzy

FuzzyMatcher interface

Fuzzy substring matcher — implementations score via Smith-Waterman local alignment (\SugarCraft\Fuzzy\Matcher\SmithWatermanMatcher) or greedy first-occurrence Sahilm matching (\SugarCraft\Fuzzy\Matcher\SahilmMatcher).

MethodSummary
match(string $query, string $candidate): ?MatchResultMatch a single candidate against the query.
score(string $query, string $candidate): intScore a single candidate WITHOUT (necessarily) building matched indices.
matchAll(string $query, iterable $candidates, ?int $limit = null, int $minScore = 1): arrayMatch a query against an iterable of candidates, returning ranked results.
matchAllGenerator(string $query, iterable $candidates, ?int $limit = null, int $minScore = 1): \GeneratorMatch a query against an iterable of candidates, yielding ranked results.

CharFold final class

Per-codepoint lowercase folding that stays 1:1 with the original string.

MethodSummary
static foldSplit(string $string): arraySplit a UTF-8 string and lowercase each code point individually.
static fold(string $char): stringLowercase a single code point. The result may be multi-code-point (U+0130 İ → i + U+0307) — callers must compare whole elements, never re-split the fold.

SmithWatermanMatcher final class

Smith-Waterman-style local alignment fuzzy matcher.

MethodSummary
__construct(?ScoringProfile $profile = null, private readonly int $maxQueryLength = self::DEFAULT_MAX_QUERY_LENGTH, private readonly int $maxCandidateLength = self::DEFAULT_MAX_CANDIDATE_LENGTH, private readonly bool $requireFullQuery = false)
static new(?ScoringProfile $profile = null, int $maxQueryLength = self::DEFAULT_MAX_QUERY_LENGTH, int $maxCandidateLength = self::DEFAULT_MAX_CANDIDATE_LENGTH, bool $requireFullQuery = false): selfNamed constructor (repo convention). Accepts every constructor option, with the same defaults, so callers never have to drop to new self(...) to tune the DoS caps or the full-query mode.
static forFiltering(): selfThe canonical filtering preset (FUZZY-13 leg b, finding sugar-fuzzy-007): local alignment scores partial hits, so a filter box would list candidates matching only a scattered subsequence; requireFullQuery keeps candidates whose alignment covers the WHOLE query — the shape command palettes want. Proof of demand: candy-code reaches this same construction from six sites (Commands/CommandRegistry.php:427, Chat.php:18606, Settings/SettingsSearch.php:68, Tui/SessionPicker.php:422, Attachments/MentionIndex.php:278 + :444 — cited as evidence only, no cross-lib edits here). Reachable both ways: new SmithWatermanMatcher( requireFullQuery: true), FuzzyMatcherFactory::named('smith-waterman', requireFullQuery: true) and this preset are the same matcher.
profile(): ScoringProfileThe scoring profile in effect.
maxQueryLength(): intQuery characters that take part in the alignment.
maxCandidateLength(): intCandidate characters (a prefix) that take part in the alignment.
requiresFullQuery(): boolWhether only alignments covering every query character count as matches.
withRequireFullQuery(bool $require = true): selfCopy of this matcher with full-query coverage required (or not).
withProfile(ScoringProfile $profile): selfCopy of this matcher using $profile for scoring (finding sugar-fuzzy-022: tuning a matcher meant rebuilding it through the constructor).
withMaxQueryLength(int $limit): selfCopy of this matcher with a new query DoS cap.
withMaxCandidateLength(int $limit): selfCopy of this matcher with a new candidate DoS cap.
match(string $query, string $candidate): ?MatchResultMatch a single candidate against the query.
score(string $query, string $candidate): intScore a candidate WITHOUT building the traceback.
matchAll(string $query, iterable $candidates, ?int $limit = null, int $minScore = 1): arrayMatch a query against an iterable of candidates, returning ranked results.
